shortDescription: Britain's Goodwin LSE:GDWN said on Wednesday it was in advanced talks with U.S.-based private equity firm Cerberus Capital Management to sell parts of its Mechanical Engineering division in a deal valued at £1.1 billion ($1.49 billion).($1 = 0.7376 pounds)
